extension.summary: Installs and updates the MediaHub skin
extension.description: Repository for the MediaHub streaming-style skin for movies and TV shows. Install the skin from Install from repository - MediaHub Repository - Look and feel - Skin, and it will be kept up to date automatically.

extension.summary: A streaming-app style skin for movies and TV shows
extension.description: MediaHub turns your Kodi movie and TV library into a modern streaming home screen: a rotating hero slider across the top, a row of network cards (Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic, Star - all customisable) that open a hub for that studio or network with its own slider, and rows you can choose and reorder: Continue Watching, Up Next, recommendations, new movies and episodes, top rated, genres and your own playlists. When an episode ends, an Up Next card shows what plays next.
extension.disclaimer: The network card artwork is plain typography. Studio and network names are trademarks of their respective owners.

extension.news: 1.3.0 - Up Next row and end-of-episode Up Next card, choose and reorder the home rows (genres, top rated, custom playlists), new subtitle download and bookmarks screens.

extension.summary: Up Next row for the MediaHub skin
extension.description: Provides the "Up Next" list used by the MediaHub skin: the next unwatched episode of every TV show you are part-way through. Playing an episode from it queues the episodes that follow.
